Private Equity Strategies Fund L.P. and Blackstone Private Equity Strategies Fund (TE) L.P. disclosed Thursday the completion of unregistered sales of limited partnership units totaling approximately $545.4 million. The information is based on a statement from the companies’ recent SEC filing.

On October 1, the funds sold limited partnership units in private offerings to accredited investors and qualified purchasers. Blackstone Private Equity Strategies Fund L.P. (BXPE U.S.) raised about $408.4 million, while Blackstone Private Equity Strategies Fund (TE) L.P. (the Feeder) raised approximately $137.0 million. The Feeder was established to enable certain tax-exempt and non-U.S. investors to participate in BXPE U.S. in a more tax-efficient manner.

The number of units sold by each fund was finalized Thursday following the calculation of their transactional net asset values (NAV) as of September 30, 2026. For BXPE U.S., the Class I-Series I units had a transactional NAV of $39.91 per unit, Class S units were valued at $38.99, Class D units at $39.54, and Class N units at $31.46. For the Feeder, Class I-Series I units had a transactional NAV of $39.48, Class S units at $38.57, and Class D units at $35.17.

The BXPE Fund Program, which includes these funds and other parallel vehicles managed by Blackstone, reported issuing interests for a total consideration of approximately $974.8 million on October 1. As of September 30, the aggregate transactional NAV for BXPE was about $19.9 billion, while the BXPE Fund Program’s aggregate transactional NAV stood at roughly $28.5 billion.

The offerings were conducted under exemptions from registration provided by Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D of the Securities Act of 1933. The funds’ transactional NAV is used to establish the price for unit transactions and may differ from net asset value calculated according to U.S. GAAP.

Neither fund has securities registered for trading on a public exchange. The filing was signed by Christopher Striano, Chief Financial Officer.
